Name: SVE DCBurger portraits (in progress)
Author: Slobbery2
Description:
I plan to drew the portraits of all the NPCs of the SVE in DCBurger style, only Sophia and Victor have been done for now, and they're still missing their swimsuit outfit portraits, but more will come, everything is in work in progress!

You need Content Patcher to use this mod, or you can move the png files into Portraiture.

NEW : 04/01- Olivia's portraits is done! You can choose between her holding a glass of wine or not!
NEW : 20/01- Claire's portraits is done! She has two types of buns, one close to her original pixel art, and the other close to the cut given by lunakatt, for those who prefer this haircut. Unlike Olivia, you have to change manually to get the version you want. To do this open the mod file, go to "assets" and open the "Claire" and "Claire_Joja" folders, choose the versions you prefer and rename them by the name of their respective folders, then replace the base file in "assets" with the version you have chosen. I put the basic version with streaks of hair. Sorry, I'll find an easier solution later.
